supports.literal_requirement: Serviço instalado e parado é iniciado por seu supervisor, sem daemon avulso concorrente.
supports.scope: Installed user tasks start the selected empty runtimes; canonical readiness confirms instance, version and Task Scheduler supervisor. Repeated start retains the same PID, birth and generation.
supports.remaining: Windows empty-runtime scope; no broader platform or provider qualification.

supports.literal_requirement: Serviço iniciado com cwd/PATH diferentes encontra executável, configuração e projeto corretos.
supports.scope: PARTIAL: inspected saved absolute executable, selected cwd/project, configuration arguments and approved PATH/environment subset; PATH normalization follows the installed Path.resolve contract. The actual registered tasks reached canonical readiness using that saved context.
supports.remaining: The campaign did not deliberately vary CLI cwd/PATH between install and start or independently sample the running child cwd/PATH. No provider, vault or effective provider configuration was exercised.

supports.literal_requirement: Instalar/habilitar serviço repetidamente não duplica recursos; alteração externa de definição é preservada.
supports.scope: PARTIAL: repeated install preserved the same owned task definition digest; repeated start also preserved the same process identity. Disable/enable each ran once per component.
supports.remaining: Repeated enable and preservation of an externally modified task definition were not exercised in this native campaign.

supports.literal_requirement: Stop explícito não aciona autorressurreição; próximo connect segue a política documentada.
supports.scope: PARTIAL: explicit canonical stop drained each empty runtime and confirmed the exact owner exited. The following bounded observations remained stopped; no automatic restart was observed in those checkpoints.
supports.remaining: The next connect and its documented restart policy were not exercised. This does not establish unlimited-duration suppression from the finite stopped checkpoints.

supports.literal_requirement: Desinstalação remove só a integração selecionada, preservando dados e execução foreground posterior.
supports.scope: PARTIAL: owner/digest-fenced uninstall removed the two selected stopped tasks and retained their disposable homes.
supports.remaining: Execution in foreground after uninstall was not exercised; bytewise preservation of all data was not measured.

public_artifact_policy: Only explicit allowlist; no raw XML, token-bearing argv, contexts, DBs, homes, credentials or raw child output.
